title: German Hash Brown Casserole
description: A hearty, oven-roasted dish from Germany, perfect for a cold winter day. This casserole combines crispy hash browns with savory onions and a hint of German flavor.
instructions: In a large skillet, sauté the chopped onion and butter until the onion is softened.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, beef broth, and milk to make a roux.
Add the roux to the skillet with the onion and stir until combined.
Add the hash browns, grated cheese, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir until the hash browns are well coated.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is heated through.
